/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in setuptools
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Setuptools may use unsafe deserialization methods (pickle, yaml, marshal) that could lead to arbitrary code execution if untrusted data is processed

/**
 * @name Critical eval in launch.py
 * @description Dangerous eval usage in setuptools launch module
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity critical
 * @id py/critical-eval-launch
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "setuptools/launch.py"
select call, "Critical eval usage in setuptools launch module that could execute arbitrary code from malicious packages"
findings.hypothesis: Critical eval usage in setuptools launch.py module that could allow arbitrary code execution from malicious packages
